finding: CPO public 4B mask builder traverses state_dict aliases while CLGRPOTrainer traverses named_parameters with duplicate removal; for tied input/output embeddings this can persist an lm_head mask/reference/index entry that the trainer never consumes.
model_anchor: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct initial public lineage (config blob d51ae92 lineage; repository commit ebb281ec70b05090aa6165b016eac8ec08e71b17 retains the same config)

release_code_facts.mask_builder_selection: per-tensor floor(10%) TopP, then discard top values equal to zero
release_code_facts.trainer_parameter_iteration: raw_model.named_parameters() / unwrapped.named_parameters() with PyTorch default remove_duplicate=true

scope_guards: The unused-alias storage/runtime overhead is conditional on the tied embedding having positive movement; compute_importance_mask.py drops a tensor when all selected differences are zero.
This is a release-code/source-algebra finding, not a measured task_k.pt size or process RSS measurement.
It does not apply to the public Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct configuration, whose tie_word_embeddings is false and whose safetensors index contains a distinct lm_head.weight.

The CPO launcher references an unpinned local Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct path; the public model config has been stable since its October 2025 initial lineage, but an unreleased local model variant cannot be ruled out without the original run artifact.
No claim is made that paper-table runs used this exact public release path.
next_test: On the smallest faithful public tied-embedding CPO run, record state_dict alias data_ptr identity, new_mask keys, exact selected counts, task_k.pt bytes, and whether lm_head.weight is absent from named_parameters(); then implement a deduplicated state_dict-by-storage control and compare files/RSS without changing the effective protected physical parameter set.
